about: FIA Women's Fashion is a Bangladesh-based women's clothing catalogue featuring linen palazzos, Swiss cotton palazzos and Swiss cotton skirts. Explore photographs by colour and contact our Facebook page to confirm measurements, prices and place an order.
delivery: FIA offers delivery across Bangladesh, subject to coverage confirmation. Delivery charges and expected delivery times depend on the address and will be confirmed through Messenger before the order is finalised. Cash on Delivery may be available when FIA confirms it.
returns: FIA advertises free replacement for verified wrong or defective items. Please contact the FIA Facebook page with your order details and clear photographs before returning anything. Eligibility, return time limits, courier arrangements, and any applicable charges must be confirmed with FIA when ordering; other exchanges and refunds are not guaranteed by this notice.
sizeIntro: Free size is not one universal measurement. Ask FIA for the confirmed waistband range, garment length and hem opening of your exact design and colour before placing an order.
privacy: This website is a public product catalogue and does not ask customers to create an account or submit an address or phone number on the site. It uses normal browser caching for performance. Cloudflare or Netlify, as the host, may process technical request information. When you contact FIA through Facebook Messenger, Meta's privacy practices also apply. Customer order information should not be included in the public website catalogue. Contact FIA through Messenger about any information you shared during an order.
customerCare: Questions about products, delivery, replacements or order details? Send a message to FIA on Facebook Messenger.
